name: fullstack-boilerplate

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace backend && npm run format --workspace frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace backend && npm run format:check --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm test --workspace backend && npm test --workspace frontend

//lint-staged: eslint is installed per workspace and is not hoisted to the root .bin, so a bare `eslint` is not on PATH for the hook. `npm exec --workspace` runs each workspace's own binary with that workspace as its cwd, which is also how the flat config gets found.
